|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Deflector Shield Generators (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-D-deflectorshieldgenerators-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-deflectorshieldgener022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/deflectorshieldgenerators.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Dark/large/deflectorshieldgenerators.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Deflector Shield Generators”. Text: “Deploy on a capital starship. Starship is power and armor +2 and immune to attrition < 5. May cancel Combined Attack or Power Pivot targeting this starship. Starfighters here may not 'attach.'”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Deflector Shield Generators (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 1 December 2022<ref name="img-deflectorshieldgenereb53af7">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/deflectorshieldgenerators.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af72c4491442a863d743950ff8a472ed77b3 commit eb53af7] (1 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Dark/large/deflectorshieldgenerators.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Deflector Shield Generators”. Text: “Deploy on a capital starship. Starship is power and armor +2 and immune to attrition < 5. May cancel Combined Attack or Power Pivot targeting this starship. Starfighters here may not 'attach.'”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Deflector Shield Generators (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-deflectorshieldgener12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/deflectorshieldgenerators.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Dark/large/deflectorshieldgenerators.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the round icon at top left changed from a firing-starship picture to a hexagonal shield picture; words are unchanged; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Deflector Shield Generators”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Deploy on a capital starship. Starship is power and armor +2 and immune to attrition < 5. May cancel Combined Attack or Power Pivot targeting this starship. Starfighters here may not 'attach.'”
